svg.title: Compare two mailbox lists by ID
svg.desc: A before-and-after report tells the team which mailbox records changed. Only in the new list. D was added. Only in the old list: C was removed. In both lists. B changed from shared to user. A kept the same type. Verify. Report each ID once. Reject a bad file before replacing a good report.
svg.text: Compare two mailbox lists by ID
A before-and-after report tells the team which mailbox records changed.
D was added. Only in the old list: C was removed.
B changed from shared to user. A kept the same type.
Report each ID once. Reject a bad file before replacing a good report.
